benefits.name: Chase Travel Hotel Credit
benefits.description: $100 statement credit for hotel bookings made through Chase Travel.
benefits.terms: Applies to hotel bookings made through the Chase Travel portal.

benefits.name: TSA PreCheck / Global Entry / NEXUS Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a TSA PreCheck, Global Entry, or NEXUS application fee.

benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass Membership
benefits.description: One year of complimentary DashPass membership from DoorDash.
benefits.terms: Requires activation. Available until Dec. 31, 2027 per current promotion; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Apple TV Subscription
benefits.description: One year complimentary Apple TV subscription.
benefits.terms: Requires activation by Dec. 31, 2026 per current promotion; confirm this deadline is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: 5x Points on Lyft
benefits.description: Earn 5x total points on eligible Lyft rides.
benefits.terms: Promotional rate through Sep. 30, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: 5x Points on Peloton
benefits.description: Earn 5x points on Peloton purchases over $150, capped at 25,000 bonus points.
benefits.terms: Minimum purchase $150. Capped at 25,000 total bonus points. Promotional rate through Dec. 31, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Primary coverage for damage/theft on most rental cars, up to $60,000, for vehicles with MSRP up to $125,000.
benefits.terms: Primary coverage (not secondary). Decline the rental company's collision coverage to activate.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $10,000 per covered traveler and $20,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $500 per covered traveler for reasonable expenses when a trip is delayed 12+ hours.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $100 a day for up to 5 days for essential purchases when checked luggage is delayed.

benefits.name: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged, or stolen checked or carry-on luggage.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days, up to $500 per item.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 3 years or less by an additional year.
